categories.cover: Opening slides. Core shape covers (3 colour tones) and photo-led covers (6 photo families).
categories.divider: Section breaks between chapters of the deck.
categories.title: Plain content slides: heading (+ sub-heading) and a body text area. The fallback for anything.
categories.closing: The Smollan end slide (logo, contact line).
categories.thankyou: Thank-you slides with a personal message and next steps.
categories.stats: Big-number proof points: 1-5 statistics, with or without photos.
categories.kpis: What we will measure: KPI grids, KPI tables and scorecards.
categories.process: Step-by-step methods: 3 to 8 steps (hard ceiling 8 per slide).
categories.infographic: Concept diagrams: triad, triangle, circular, pivot-point (Venn), loop, cycle, SWOT.
categories.buckets: 'Here are N things' grids: 4-8 text buckets, optionally with a photo per bucket.
categories.graphs: Native, editable charts: 1 or 2 per slide, with intro, description or text columns.
categories.tables: Styled tables: comparison grids, tick matrices, gantt, scenario tables (incl. Growth Teams styles).
categories.org: Team structures: drawn from tree data, or bespoke fixed-shape org charts (with photos).
categories.feedback: Client survey feedback: quote + survey bar chart + action-plan date.
categories.devices: Screens on devices: laptop, browser, phone(s) and video frames for app/dashboard shots.
categories.why: Why Smollan: 4 pillars and custom differentiator grids.
